en.headline: Nine people shot at Strathmore concert on November 21
en.body: The shooting occurred on November 21 at a concert in Strathmore, according to The Straits Times and SFist. About 150 people attended the event, The Straits Times reported.

es.headline: Nueve personas fueron disparadas en el concierto de Strathmore el 21 de noviembre
es.body: El tiroteo ocurrió el 21 de noviembre en un concierto en Strathmore, según The Straits Times y SFist. The Straits Times informó que asistieron unas 150 personas al evento.

de.headline: Neun Personen bei Schusswechsel auf Konzert in Strathmore am 21. November
de.body: Der Schusswechsel ereignete sich am 21. November bei einem Konzert in Strathmore, wie The Straits Times und SFist berichten. Laut The Straits Times nahmen etwa 150 Personen an der Veranstaltung teil.

it.headline: Nove persone ferite in sparatoria a concerto a Strathmore il 21 novembre
it.body: La sparatoria è avvenuta il 21 novembre durante un concerto a Strathmore, secondo The Straits Times e SFist. The Straits Times ha riportato che l'evento ha avuto circa 150 partecipanti.

fr.headline: Neuf personnes tirées lors d'un concert à Strathmore le 21 novembre
fr.body: La fusillade a eu lieu le 21 novembre lors d'un concert à Strathmore, selon The Straits Times et SFist. Environ 150 personnes ont assisté à l'événement, rapporte The Straits Times.

pt.headline: Nove pessoas foram baleadas num concerto em Strathmore a 21 de novembro
pt.body: O tiroteio ocorreu a 21 de novembro num concerto em Strathmore, segundo o The Straits Times e o SFist. Cerca de 150 pessoas compareceram ao evento, reportou o The Straits Times.

zh.headline: 11月21日斯特拉斯莫尔音乐会遭枪击九人受伤
zh.body: 据《海峡时报》和SFist报道，枪击事件发生在11月21日在斯特拉斯莫尔的一场音乐会上。《海峡时报》报道，约有150人出席了该活动。

ja.headline: 11月21日のストラズモアのコンサートで9人が銃撃される
ja.body: ストラズタイムスとSFistによると、銃撃事件は11月21日にストラズモアのコンサートで発生した。ストラズタイムスは、このイベントには約150人が参加したと報じている。

ko.headline: 11월 21일 스트라스모어 콘서트에서 9명 총격 피해
ko.body: 스트레이츠 타임스와 SFist에 따르면 총격 사건은 11월 21일 스트라스모어에서 열린 콘서트에서 발생했다. 스트레이츠 타임스는 약 150명이 이 행사에 참석했다고 보도했다.

en.title: Nine people shot at Strathmore concert on November 21, one in critical condition
en.dek: A mass shooting at a private concert in central California left nine injured, authorities said.
facts: Nine people were shot at a concert in Strathmore on November 21
One victim remains in critical condition
The shooting occurred at a private concert in central California
body: Nine people were shot at a concert in Strathmore on November 21, according to The Straits Times and SFist.
One victim remains in critical condition following the incident, authorities reported.
The shooting occurred on November 21 at a concert in Strathmore, according to The Straits Times and SFist.
About 150 people attended the event, The Straits Times reported.
The incident took place at a private concert in central California, SFist reported.
Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the shooting at the Strathmore venue.
en.context: A mass shooting occurred at a private concert in Strathmore, California on November 21, 2026, leaving nine people injured.
